survey_findings: CONFIRMED, water builder: IMPLEMENTED_AI was {none, hold_ground, scripted}; the AGGRO branch set b.state='REPOSITION' and only turned yaw. Nothing wrote b.pos.

EXTENDED: there IS one pursuit locomotion and it is character/encounter.js::engageMember (W1-07). Every wilderness body carries an encounterId, so that beeline was in practice this game's enemy AI. It scores 2/18 against RI-AI01.

THE DEAD ROAD IS EXPLAINED, three compounding causes: (a) the only pursuit speed in the game is 2.20 m/s against a player who walks at 2.0, jogs at 3.2 and sprints at 5.0, so closure on a walking player is 0.20 m/s and 137 m of road; (b) the enemy is stationary for the whole of every attack animation, handing back 2.4-5.1 m per swing; (c) world/population.js releases a post on the distance from its ANCHOR, not from the chasing body, so the chase is despawned 260 m after the anchor. 689-479=210 m is one such window.

Aggro was a bare proximity circle with no cone, no LOS, no meter - RI-AI01 M1's named failure - and for wl-slitherfang-* (20 m) and wl-drowned-straggler (16 m) the circle is WIDER than the statblock's own sight radius (16 and 14). Nothing in this world could be sneaked past. Also an RI-STL01 finding.

Roster: 7 combat statblocks over 3 of RI-AI05's 10 archetypes. Four of the seven are the same INFANTRY chassis at different HP. champion_hist_marked is tier elite, archetype INFANTRY, 7x HP - RI-AI05 lever 6 in place of lever 1. No BOSS, no ELITE archetype, no RANGED, no TURTLE, no POISE_MONSTER, no AMBUSHER, no DUELIST.
INSTRUMENT DEFECT: sim/record.js had TWO keys named `los` in one object literal, the later being the constant true. Every enemy record this project has produced reported los=true. FIXED.

INSTRUMENT DEFECT: sim/combat-bridge.js::mirror() never wrote e.speed or e.yawRate, so speed_mps and yaw_rate_dps read 0 forever for every combat-driven enemy. RI-AI01 M7 - a binary hard fail - was unfalsifiable, and M3's STATUE clause was satisfied by a field nobody wrote. FIXED.
INSTRUMENT DEFECT: tools/lib/combat-node.mjs declared jog 4.4 / sprint 6.6 against the game's 3.2 / 5.0. FIXED, and it is exactly the number this piece's central question turns on.

ITEM GAP, reported not exploited: RI-AI01 M4's inter-COMMIT coefficient-of-variation test does NOT detect this build's attack timer. attack_cadence_f is a single constant 78 f, but three of the four rotated attacks are longer than that, so the interval is set by whichever animation is playing and a fixed rotation of differently-lengthed moves manufactures CoV ~0.3 out of no decision. A critic scoring M4 off a trace would clear the most timer-driven enemy in the project.

NEW, from the repaired speed field: max_speed_mps in the browser is 18.211 m/s. That is not the AI (capped at the 4.6 m/s archetype sprint) - it is attack ROOT MOTION, root_dz_m 0.6-1.2 m consumed over a handful of active frames. An enemy swing translates its body at 18 m/s. Invisible before, because the field was zero. RI-CMB04 / W1-09 owns it; raised, not absorbed.

RI-AI01 M1 is a PARTIAL in the shipping game and the reason is W1-15 s: the acquisition geometry is correct (not a circle, rear-blind, respects R) but the perception fill rate is roughly 2.5x too slow for the item s "acquires at 0.9R within 3 s" leg.

CLOSED A NEIGHBOUR'S NAMED DEBT: game/data/combat/enemies/guard_legion.json (edited by W1-15-r3 this session) says an AGGRO'd guard deals 0 damage and names it 'W1-12's to close'. ai.json's override maps guard_legion to souls; measured 14 commits and player HP 620 -> 0 over 3600 frames. No statblock was edited to do it.

ACCIDENTAL CONFIRMATION of the roster finding: ai-probe --stat=guard_legion returns spacing_variance 1.746, CoV 0.1724, 14 commits, feint ratio 0.263 - IDENTICAL to four decimals to inf_trash, because guard_legion's own provenance says its frames, hitboxes and moveset are inf_trash's unchanged. Two differently-named enemies are the same fight frame for frame.
